rows.title: Potential of Ginkgo biloba Extract to Intervene in Chronic Inflammation-Related Diseases.
rows.evidence_boundary: The review spans standardized Ginkgo extracts and multiple inflammation-related diseases across preclinical and clinical evidence; formulation and disease heterogeneity prevent broad efficacy claims.

rows.title: Energy Drink Use and Adolescent Sleep Debt: Implications for Obesity, Cognition, and Physical Activity.
rows.evidence_boundary: The adolescent evidence is largely observational and behavioral; energy-drink use may be both a marker and contributor to sleep debt, so causality and ingredient-specific effects remain uncertain.

rows.title: The Gut-Heart Axis in Cardiovascular Disease: Microbial Metabolites, Mediterranean and Traditional Turkish Dietary Patterns, and Personalized Medicine.
rows.evidence_boundary: The review integrates microbiome metabolites and dietary-pattern evidence; associations and mechanistic pathways do not establish efficacy for a particular probiotic, prebiotic, or supplement.

rows.title: Acute caffeine strategies for improving performance in combat sports: a structured narrative review.
rows.evidence_boundary: Acute performance responses depend on sport, caffeine dose, timing, delivery form, training status, and habitual intake; findings do not establish chronic benefit or a universal protocol.

rows.title: Nutraceutical Intervention of Probiotics in Vision Science: A Systematic Review of Evolving Perspective.
rows.evidence_boundary: Gut-eye and ocular-microbiome evidence is evolving and heterogeneous across strains, conditions, and study designs; it does not establish class-wide probiotic efficacy for eye disease.
